releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.25 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Precision Leaf-Targeting for AdMob/Google Ads rewarded pills (✕ icon hitboxes)
* Post-Click Verification: Prevents premature 'Ad skipped' announcements before real dismissal
* Anti-Toggle Quarantine Fix: Shields legitimate skip/close buttons from being quarantined
* On-Device Stuck Ad Extraction: Mirrored offline screenshot cache & SQLite dump to external storage for ADB analysis
* History & Memory UI: Enhanced pin reticle presets for rewarded pill ✕ and corner close targets
